title: qDATA Version 1.1 – Fold-Change Correction by Implementation of Jensen’s Inequality
content: qDATA is an open-source R-based bioinformatics application designed to enable fast and reliable qRT-PCR data analysis within a robust and user-friendly graphical interface. The original software implementation is presented in detail elsewhere and the present paper describes qDATA v1.1 that contains new implementations for enhancing data analysis accuracy.
